title: A stabilized presentation with an initial localized conormal basis
statement: Let $R$ and $A$ be commutative rings with $A$ a finitely presented $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Let $P_0:R[x_1,\ldots,x_{n_0}]\twoheadrightarrow A$ be a finite polynomial presentation with $m_0$ relations [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], kernel $I_0$, and conormal module $I_0/I_0^2$ with its quotient $A$-action. Let $a\in A$, $B=A_a$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away], and assume that $B$ is smooth over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. Suppose $r,q\geq0$ and $(B\otimes_A I_0/I_0^2)\oplus B^r\cong B^q$ as $B$-modules. Then there are $n,m,c\geq0$, a finite presentation $P:R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]\twoheadrightarrow A$ with relations $f_0,\ldots,f_{m-1}$ and kernel $I$, and $c\leq\min(n,m)$, such that the elements $1\otimes(f_j\bmod I^2)$, $0\leq j<c$, are a basis of $B\otimes_A I/I^2$.

source.place: Tag 07EZ (lemma-compare-standard), proof of (e), stabilization by zero variables and selection of the initial relations; rank bound made explicit

proof.text: If B=A_a is the zero ring, retain P₀ and choose the empty basis of its zero localized conormal module, with c=0. The two size inequalities and all basis-value assertions are then vacuous.
If B is nonzero, apply the fixed-size stabilization and numerator-relation construction. It supplies n=n₀+r, c=q, a presentation P, q≤m and a Fin q basis consisting of its initial relation classes.

Apply the existing Presentation.localized_conormal_equiv to P, and compose the resulting equivalence with the injection of the conormal module into the first factor. Map the Fin q basis through this injection. Mathlib Module.Basis.card_le_card_of_linearIndependent applied to Pi.basisFun gives q≤n₀+r over the nonzero commutative ring B. Combine with q≤m to get q≤min(n₀+r,m). The initial-relation equality is unchanged by proof irrelevance for Fin.castLE.

theorem exists_presentation_localized_conormal_basis
    (R : Type u) (A : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [FinitePresentation R A] (a : A) [Smooth R (Localization.Away a)]
    {n₀ m₀ : ℕ} (P₀ : Presentation R A (Fin n₀) (Fin m₀)) (r q : ℕ)
    (hstable : Nonempty
      (((Localization.Away a ⊗[A] P₀.toExtension.Cotangent) ×
        (Fin r → Localization.Away a)) ≃ₗ[Localization.Away a]
        (Fin q → Localization.Away a))) :
    ∃ (n m c : ℕ) (P : Presentation R A (Fin n) (Fin m)) (hc : c ≤ min n m)
      (b : Module.Basis (Fin c) (Localization.Away a)
        (Localization.Away a ⊗[A] P.toExtension.Cotangent)),
      ∀ j : Fin c, b j = 1 ⊗ₜ[A]
        (Extension.Cotangent.mk (P := P.toExtension)
          ⟨P.relation (Fin.castLE (le_trans hc (min_le_right n m)) j),
            P.relation_mem_ker _⟩)
